Aura of Hate Lv. 1 Uses 4312 Power to provoke nearby enemies to attack.
Aggression Lv. 1 Provokes the target to attack with 3928 Power.
Sting Lv. 1 Attacks an enemy with 82 Power added to P. Atk., and inflicts Bleed causing loss of 25 HP per second, inflicts minor damage based on walked distance. Over-hit is possible.
Shield Strike Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage on multiple enemies. Power: 833. Provokes multiple enemies to attack only in PvE. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Challenge for Fate Lv. 1 Switches multiple enemies' target and locks it for 5 sec. Provokes multiple enemies to attack. Applies to your character: P. Def. +15% M. Def +15%.
Confusion Lv. 1 Throws an enemy into confusion, changing their target of attack.
Summon Vampiric Cubic Lv. 1 Summons a Vampiric Cubic. A Vampiric Cubic uses magic that absorbs the target's HP and with it regenerates its master's HP.
Summon Phantom Cubic Lv. 1 Summons Phantom Cubic. A Phantom Cubic uses magic that Target's P. Atk., P. Def., and Atk. Spd.
Drain Health Lv. 1 Inflicts dark damage on the target with 20 Power added to M. Atk. Absorbs 20% of the damage inflicted on target as HP.
Summon Viper Cubic Lv. 1 Summons a Viper Cubic. The Viper Cubic uses magic that Gloom and Poison a targeted enemy.
Life Leech Lv. 1 Inflicts non-Attribute damage on an enemy with 26 Power added to M. Atk. Absorbs 80% of the damage as HP.
Summon Smart Cubic Lv. 1 Summons Smart Cubic. This Cubic: Inflicts magic damage on enemy. Switches enemy's target. Removes all debuffs from the master.
Attack Aura Lv. 1 P. Atk. +6%.
Defence Aura Lv. 1 P. Def. +6%.

Deflect Arrow Lv. 1 Resistance to Bow attacks +8%.

Iron Shield Lv. 1 When taking 100 or more damage with a Shield equipped, 30% chance: Shield Defence Power +30%. Duration: 60 sec. Reuse time: 15 sec.

Shield of Faith Lv. 1 For party members: P. Def. +900 M. Def. +600 Redirects 30% of any received damage to the character who cast it. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Skill only works while in a party with the caster.
Anti Magic Armor Lv. 1 M. Def. +150%.
Deflect Magic Lv. 1 Magic Block Chance +100% (by 2 times).
Shield Deflect Magic Lv. 1 Transfers magical damage back to an enemy caster with 20% chance.
Combat Aura Lv. 1 For your character and party members: P. Atk. +3% Atk. Spd. +2% M. Atk. +3% Cast. Spd. +2% Incoming Heal Power +3%.
Royal Sacrifice Lv. 1 You increases P. Def. by 30% and M. Def. by 30% of your target (party member) while transferring 90% of incoming damage on yourself.

Shillien's Arcane Lv. 1 M. Atk. +25%.

Spirit of Shillien Lv. 1 For party members: Speed +10 Atk. Spd. +7% P. Atk. +10% M. Atk. +20% P. Crit. Rate with Swords, Daggers +20 P. Crit. Damage with Blunts, Fists +10% Recovers as HP 15% of standard melee damage inflicted on an enemy Incoming Heal Power -30%. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Skill only works while in a party with the caster. Only one of these effects can be active at a time: 'Flame Icon', 'Touch of Eva', or 'Spirit of Shillien'.
Corpse Plague Lv. 1 Causes a poison cloud to pour out of a corpse. Inflicts poison on enemies near the corpse, and makes them consume 41 HP every second.
Freezing Strike Lv. 1 Temporarily freezes the surrounding air, inflicting Water damage on an enemy with 26 Power and decreasing their Speed by 20%.
Power Break Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's P. Atk. by 20%.
Hex Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's P. Def. by 23%.
Poison Lv. 1 Poisons the target, causing loss of 24 HP per second. Speed -5%, Incoming Heal Power -7%.

Lightning Strike Lv. 1 Strikes an enemy with a lightning bolt that inflicts non-Attribute damage with 82 Power added to M. Atk., and decreases Speed by 50%, Atk. Spd. by 50%, Cast Spd. by 50%. When the effect ends, you are completely paralyzed for 10 seconds.

Touch of Death Lv. 1 Sacrifices oneself to pronounce an Dark curse on the enemy. Cancels up to 3 buffs with 25% probability and consumes 90% CP., decreases Max CP by 90% and the Healing power received by 30%. Increases susceptibility to de-buff by 30%.
Shield Bash Lv. 1 Hits an enemy with user's shield and stuns them. Target cancel chance: 70%. While active: Resistance to Stun +99%. Duration: 4 sec.

Arrest Lv. 1 Provokes an enemy to attack, then immobilizes them.
Banish Seraph Lv. 1 Frightens an angel into fleeing and decreases Speed by 50%. Lethal Strike is possible.
Shield Whirlwind Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage. Power: 946. Applies to enemy: Speed -75% Atk. Spd. -75% Cast. Spd. -75%. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. Minimal range: 200.
